postings.title: Spotlight - Test
postings.description:
Know Someone Who Would Be a Great Fit for Kirby?

We're always looking to connect with talented people who share our values and have the skills, ambition, and attitude to help drive Kirby's continued success.

Use this section to submit details of individuals from your network who you believe would be a strong addition to our team. Whether they are experienced professionals, emerging talent, or industry specialists, we encourage referrals across all disciplines and levels.

By referring great people, you help us build a stronger organisation while creating opportunities for exceptional candidates to join one of the industry's leading companies.
